nodes.long_description: Bắt đầu cuộc phiêu lưu thành phố! Trash Cat: Street Run mang đến hành trình 3D sắc màu. Đặc điểm: Chạy vui nhộn, thu thập cá, né vật cản và thoát khỏi chó dữ.
nodes.short_description: Chạy và nhảy qua thành phố! Giúp chú mèo đói bụng thu thập cá và né tránh vật cản. Bạn có thể đi bao xa?

nodes.long_description: Ξεκινήστε τη μεγάλη περιπέτεια στην πόλη! Το Trash Cat: Street Run είναι ένα συναρπαστικό ταξίδι σε μια 3D πόλη. Χαρακτηριστικά: Διασκεδαστική δράση, συλλογή ψαριών, αποφυγή εμποδίων και καταδίωξη από σκύλο.
nodes.short_description: Τρέξτε, πηδήξτε και ορμήστε στην πόλη! Βοηθήστε μια πεινασμένη γάτα, μαζέψτε ψάρια και αποφύγετε εμπόδια. Πόσο μακριά μπορείτε να φτάσετε;

nodes.long_description: Commencez votre grande aventure urbaine ! Trash Cat: Street Run vous plonge dans une ville 3D colorée. Caractéristiques : Action de course fun, collecte de poissons, évitement d'obstacles et fuite devant le chien.
nodes.short_description: Courez, sautez et foncez en ville ! Aidez un chat affamé à naviguer, collectez des poissons et évitez les obstacles. Jusqu'où irez-vous ?

nodes.long_description:
Start Your Big City Adventure!

Get ready for an exciting journey with Trash Cat: Street Run. Step into a colorful 3D city where you must help a fast cat run as far as possible. The street is full of surprises, and you will need quick reflexes to stay safe, collect rewards, and keep moving!

Why You Will Love It:
Fun Running Action: Move left, right, and jump to avoid everything in your way. It is easy to play but gets more exciting as you go faster.

Collect Tasty Fish: Keep an eye out for fish along the track! Collect as many as you can to increase your score and become the top cat.

Dodge Tricky Obstacles: Watch out for mice running on the road, trash cans, and wooden boxes. One wrong move and the run is over!

Escape the Barking Dog: Stay alert because a white dog is always ready to stop your fun. Stay fast to keep ahead of the chase.

Beautiful 3D City: Run through bright streets with realistic buildings and sunny views that look great in VR.

Put on your headset, grab those fish, and help the Trash Cat conquer the city streets today!
nodes.short_description: Run, jump, and dash through the city! In Trash Cat: Street Run, you help a hungry cat navigate busy city streets. Collect tasty fish to earn points while dodging tricky obstacles like mice, trash cans, and barking dogs. How far can you go in this fast and fun 3D escape adventure?

nodes.long_description: Start ditt store byeventyr! Trash Cat: Street Run er en spennende reise i en fargerik 3D-by. Funksjoner: Morsom løpeaction, samle fisk for poeng, unngå hindringer och flykt fra hunden.
nodes.short_description: Løp, hopp og dash gjennom byen! Hjelp en sulten katt, saml fisk og unngå hindringer. Hvor langt kan du gå i dette 3D-eventyret?

nodes.long_description: Начните приключение в большом городе! Trash Cat: Street Run — это яркое 3D-путешествие. Особенности: веселый раннер, сбор рыбы, уклонение от препятствий и побег от собаки.
nodes.short_description: Бегайте и прыгайте по городу! Помогите голодному коту собирать рыбу и избегать препятствий. Как далеко вы сможете пробежать?

nodes.long_description: Začněte své velké městské dobrodružství! Trash Cat: Street Run vás zavede do barevného 3D světa. Vlastnosti: Zábavná běžecká akce, sbírání ryb pro body, vyhýbání se překážkám a únik před štěkajícím psem.
nodes.short_description: Běhejte, skákejte a uhánějte městem! Pomozte hladové kočce v rušných ulicích sbírat ryby a vyhýbat se překážkám. Jak daleko doběhnete?

nodes.long_description: 开启你的大城市冒险！体验色彩斑斓的3D城市。游戏特色：趣味奔跑动作、收集小鱼赢取高分、躲避障碍物以及逃离追赶的小狗。立即加入！
nodes.short_description: 在城市中奔跑跳跃！帮助饥饿的小猫穿梭街道，收集小鱼并躲避老鼠和恶狗。你能跑多远？

nodes.long_description: ¡Empieza tu aventura en la ciudad! Trash Cat: Street Run te lleva a una colorida ciudad 3D. Características: Divertida acción de carrera, recoge peces, esquiva obstáculos y escapa del perro.
nodes.short_description: ¡Corre, salta y deslízate por la ciudad! Ayuda a un gato hambriento, recoge peces y esquiva obstáculos. ¿Qué tan lejos puedes llegar?

nodes.long_description: Inizia la tua grande avventura in città! Trash Cat: Street Run ti porta in una colorata città 3D. Caratteristiche: Azione di corsa divertente, raccogli pesci per i punti, schiva gli ostacoli e scappa dal cane.
nodes.short_description: Corri, salta e sfreccia in città! Aiuta un gatto affamato tra le strade, raccogli pesci ed evita gli ostacoli. Quanto lontano puoi arrivare?

nodes.long_description: Starta ditt stadssäventyr! Trash Cat: Street Run är en resa i en färgglad 3D-stad. Innehåller: Rolig löparaction, samla fisk för poäng, undvik hinder och fly från hunden.
nodes.short_description: Spring, hoppa och rusa genom staden! Hjälp en hungrig katt att samla fisk och undvika hinder. Hur långt kan du komma?

nodes.long_description: 대도시 모험을 시작하세요! Trash Cat: Street Run은 화려한 3D 도시에서의 여정입니다. 특징: 즐거운 러닝 액션, 물고기 수집, 장애물 피하기, 그리고 짖는 개로부터 도망치기.
nodes.short_description: 도시를 달리고, 점프하고, 질주하세요! 고양이를 도와 물고기를 모으고 장애물을 피하세요. 얼마나 멀리 갈 수 있을까요?

nodes.long_description: Start dit store byeventyr! Trash Cat: Street Run er en spændende rejse i en farverig 3D-by. Funktioner: Sjov løbeaction, saml fisk for point, undvig forhindringer og undslip den gøende hund.
nodes.short_description: Løb, hop og stryg gennem byen! Hjælp en sulten kat med at navigere i travle gader, samle fisk og undgå mus og hunde. Hvor langt kan du nå?

nodes.long_description: ¡Empieza tu aventura en la ciudad! Trash Cat: Street Run te lleva a una colorida ciudad 3D. Recursos: Divertida acción de carrera, recoge peces, esquiva obstáculos y escapa del perro.
nodes.short_description: ¡Corre, salta y deslízate por la ciudad! Ayuda a un gato hambriento, recoge peces y esquiva obstáculos. ¿Qué tan lejos puedes llegar?

nodes.long_description: Begin je grote stadsavontuur! Trash Cat: Street Run brengt je naar een kleurrijke 3D-stad. Kenmerken: Leuke hardloopactie, verzamel vissen voor punten, ontwijk obstakels en ontsnap aan de blaffende hond.
nodes.short_description: Ren, spring en dash door de stad! Help een hongerige kat door drukke straten, verzamel vissen en ontwijk obstakels. Hoe ver kun jij komen?

nodes.long_description: Aloita suuri kaupunkiseikkailusi! Trash Cat: Street Run on jännittävä matka värikkäässä 3D-kaupungissa. Ominaisuudet: Hauskaa juoksutoimintaa, kerää kaloja pisteitä varten ja pakene haukkuvaa koiraa.
nodes.short_description: Juokse, hypi ja syöksy läpi kaupungin! Auta nälkäistä kissaa vilkkailla kaduilla, kerää kaloja ja väistä esteitä. Kuinka pitkälle pääset?

nodes.long_description: 都会の大冒険を始めよう！『Trash Cat: Street Run』はカラフルな3Dの街を舞台にしたランニングゲームです。特徴：爽快なアクション、魚集め、障害物回避、そして追いかけてくる犬から逃げ切ろう。
nodes.short_description: 街を走り、跳び、駆け抜けろ！お腹を空かせた猫を助けて魚を集め、障害物をかわして進もう。どこまで遠くへ行けるかな？

nodes.long_description: Rozpocznij wielką przygodu w mieście! Trash Cat: Street Run to ekscytująca podróż w kolorowym świecie 3D. Cechy: Zabawna akcja biegowa, zbieranie ryb, omijanie przeszkód i ucieczka przed psem.
nodes.short_description: Biegaj, skacz i pędź przez miasto! Pomóż głodnemu kotu zbierać ryby i unikać przeszkód. Jak daleko uda Ci się dobiec?

nodes.long_description: Começa a tua grande aventura na cidade! Trash Cat: Street Run leva-te a uma cidade 3D colorida. Características: Ação de corrida divertida, recolha de peixes, desvia-te de obstáculos e foge do cão.
nodes.short_description: Corre, salta e corre pela cidade! Ajuda um gato faminto, recolhe peixes e desvia-te de obstáculos. Quão longe consegues chegar?

nodes.long_description: Comece sua grande aventura na cidade! Trash Cat: Street Run leva você a uma cidade 3D colorida. Recursos: Ação de corrida divertida, colete peixes, desvie de obstáculos e fuja do cachorro.
nodes.short_description: Corra, pule e dispare pela cidade! Ajude um gato faminto, colete peixes e desvie de obstáculos. Quão longe você consegue ir?

nodes.long_description: Büyük Şehir Macerasına Başlayın! Trash Cat: Street Run sizi renkli bir 3D şehre götürüyor. Özellikler: Eğlenceli koşu aksiyonu, balık toplama, engellerden kaçma ve köpekten kurtulma.
nodes.short_description: Şehirde koşun ve zıplayın! Aç bir kedinin balık toplamasına ve engellerden kaçmasına yardım edin. Ne kadar ileri gidebilirsin?

nodes.long_description: Starten Sie Ihr großes Stadtabenteuer! Trash Cat: Street Run bietet spannende 3D-Action. Features: Lustige Lauf-Action, Fische sammeln für Highscores, Hindernissen ausweichen und dem Hund entkommen.
nodes.short_description: Rennen, springen und flitzen Sie durch die Stadt! Helfen Sie einer Katze, Fische zu sammeln und Hindernissen auszuweichen. Wie weit kommen Sie?

nodes.long_description: 開啟你的大城市冒險！體驗色彩斑斕的3D城市。遊戲特色：趣味奔跑動作、收集小魚贏取高分、躲避障礙物以及逃離追趕的小狗。立即加入！

nodes.long_description: Începe marea ta aventură urbană! Trash Cat: Street Run este o călătorie captivantă într-un oraș 3D colorat. Caracteristici: Acțiune distractivă, colectare de pești și fuga de câine.
nodes.short_description: Fugi, sari și aleargă prin oraș! Ajută o pisică flămândă, colectează pești și evită obstacolele. Cât de departe poți ajunge?

nodes.long_description: Începe marea ta aventură urbană! Trash Cat: Street Run este o călătorie captivantă într-un oraș 3D colorat. Caracteristici: Acțiune distractivă, colectare de pești și fuga de câine.
nodes.short_description: Fugi, sari și aleargă prin oraș! Ajută o pisică flămândă, colectează pești și evită obstacolele. Cât de departe poți ajunge?

nodes.long_description: Start Your Big City Adventure! Get ready for an exciting journey with Trash Cat: Street Run. Features: Fun running action, collect fish for points, dodge tricky obstacles, and escape the barking dog in a beautiful 3D VR city.
nodes.short_description: Run, jump, and dash through the city! Help a hungry cat navigate busy streets, collect fish, and dodge obstacles. How far can you go in this 3D escape?
